items.title: Instagram Modernized its UI with an AI-Native Architecture, Cutting Token Costs by 33%
items.summaryShort: Instagram Modernized its UI with an AI-Native Architecture, Cutting Token Costs by 33%. Instagram Direct migrated its Android UI from the legacy Android View system to Jetpack Compose, creating an AI-native UI codebase that is easier for AI

items.title: Optimizing Software Workflow: Exploring Fundamental Impacts in Technology
items.summaryShort: Optimizing Software Workflow: Exploring Fundamental Impacts in Technology. Software only has value when shipped; faster release cadence matters.

items.title: Presentation: What 25 Trillion Tokens Reveal About How Developers Actually Adopt AI Agents
items.summaryShort: Presentation: What 25 Trillion Tokens Reveal About How Developers Actually Adopt AI Agents. Brendan O'Leary discusses how real-world AI adoption depends on building trust rather than chasing model benchmarks.

items.title: Grafana Tempo 3.1 Adds Query-Based Trace Redaction and Sampling-Aware TraceQL Metrics
items.summaryShort: Grafana Tempo 3.1 Adds Query-Based Trace Redaction and Sampling-Aware TraceQL Metrics. Grafana Labs has released Tempo 3.1, the first minor update to the 3.0 architecture.

items.title: Article: Server-Side DPoP and Token Exchange in Spring Security 7
items.summaryShort: Article: Server-Side DPoP and Token Exchange in Spring Security 7. Spring Authorization Server now lives inside Spring Security 7 under the same Maven coordinates, so the upgrade is a version bump.

items.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
items.summaryShort: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style. The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.

items.title: When it came to Cal AI's viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
items.summaryShort: When it came to Cal AI's viral success, a small army of influencers paid off. The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

items.title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
items.summaryShort: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems. Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.
